title: From Teacher to Tech: How to Make a Career Pivot from the Classroom
description:
How can you go from teaching in a classroom to working in tech? Career change for teachers can be daunting—but in this LinkedIn Live, we chat with teacher-turned-recruiter Myquasia Chambers about how she pivoted from teaching to recruiting—and how other teachers can do the same. 

Have questions about how to make the transition from teaching to tech? Or how to pivot to a new industry? Let us know in the comments.
